sj-business-tax.form_seen: San José Business Tax Certificate registration (online)

fields.en: Start date of business in San José
fields.zh: 在圣何塞开始营业日期

fields.en: Tax ID number (FEIN, SSN and/or TIN)
Driver's license number of the principal owner
Telephone number
Names and addresses of the owner(s)
Address of each San José location
fields.zh: 每个圣何塞经营地点地址

fields.en: Email address
Contractor's number and type, if applicable
fields.zh: 承包商执照号及类型（如适用）

fields.en: State seller's permit number, if applicable
fields.zh: 州销售许可证号（如适用）

fields.en: County health permit number, if applicable
fields.zh: 县卫生许可证号（如适用）

destination.evidence: Register online within 90 days of starting business; paying during registration activates the account in 2 to 3 business days.

sj-business-tax.notes: Unpaid registrations get a mailed invoice in 5 to 10 business days; the certificate is mailed after payment.

scc-plan-check.form_seen: Plan Check Application (PC_Application) with the Food Plan Check Checklist

fields.en: Scope of work
Total number of Type I and Type II hoods
fields.zh: I 类及 II 类排烟罩总数

attach.zh: 填好的食品图纸审查核查表

attach.en: One bound, legible set of 1/4-inch scale plans: equipment, mechanical, finish schedule, plumbing, electrical
attach.zh: 一套装订清晰、1/4 英寸比例的图纸：设备、暖通、饰面表、给排水、电气

attach.en: Manufacturer specification sheets for proposed equipment
attach.zh: 拟用设备的厂家规格表

mail.name: County of Santa Clara, Department of Environmental Health

destination.evidence: Items must be submitted as one packet; complete packets are accepted by email, by mail, or in person at 1555 Berger Drive, Bldg #2, Suite #300.

scc-plan-check.notes: Incomplete packets are not accepted; plans with no payment are discarded after 10 business days. DEH reviews within 20 business days. After approval submit two more sets for stamping, then two stamped sets to the city. The email address is hidden on the page.

scc-health-permit.form_seen: Health permit to operate (issued after plan check and final inspection)

mail.name: County of Santa Clara, Department of Environmental Health

destination.evidence: New food facilities start with the Plan Check Application packet; the permit follows the approved plans and final inspection.

scc-health-permit.notes: The library pointed to the plan review page; the new-facility page is the right entry point.

attach.zh: 商业与工业项目提交核查表

attach.en: Plans per the Tenant Improvements Plan Checklist
attach.zh: 按租户改造图纸核查表准备的图纸

attach.en: Owner-Builder Acknowledgement, if the owner applies
attach.zh: 如业主自行申请，需业主自建确认书

destination.evidence: Forms may require digital signatures. Whoever signs the building permit application is responsible and potentially liable for all activity under the permit.

sj-building-ti.notes: The city advises a licensed contractor as applicant. STAR service is faster (premium fee); a refundable construction and demolition diversion deposit applies.

attach.en: The documents, photographs or plans in the application's 'What to Submit' section
attach.zh: 申请表“提交内容”部分列出的文件、照片或图纸

destination.evidence: Be sure to include any required documentation for staff to deem your application complete and a Digital Signature.

sj-sign.notes: Staff invoice after the completeness check; the receipt appears in the SJPermits account.
